docs.title: Integration docs
docs.signingBody: Every request carries X-YourTal-Signature: t=[unix seconds],k=[key id],v1=[hex hmac-sha256]. Your key id is the credential's id, and the key is the secret shown once when you issue it, hex-decoded to bytes. The MAC covers a newline-joined canonical string: the timestamp, your key id, the HTTP method, the path and query, the Idempotency-Key header (or an empty string), and base64(sha256(request body)). Use @yourtal/sdk-merchant's signRequest directly, passing the secret as Buffer.from(secret, "hex"). It is byte-identical to the server's own verifier.
docs.callAuthorize: authorize — look up a voucher by code and reserve an amount. Does not move value yet.
docs.callCapture: capture — finalises a prior authorization for the amount actually charged.
docs.callVoid: void — cancels an authorization that was never captured.
docs.callRefund: refund — reverses some or all of a capture, identified by your own reference.
docs.callsDeviceNote: A device-scoped credential (the one a paired counter uses) can never void or refund — only a merchant-wide key issued here can.
docs.errorsBody: Every failure is a JSON object with code and message fields. Branch on code, never on parsing message — that string is for a human, not your integration.
docs.idempotencyBody: Send one Idempotency-Key per logical call and reuse it, with the identical body, on every retry. A repeated key and body gets the same answer back rather than a second redemption.
